Jordan (AE): Heads-up: NovaBank wants a 30-day POC. Requirements: SAML SSO (Okta), SCIM provisioning with group->role mapping, domain-locked tenant, and 1 year audit retention. Can we confirm blockers and pricing?
Alisa (SE): We can do domain-locked hosted tenants (DNS TXT verification). SAML flows supported with signed assertions + cert rotation. SCIM: support group membership -> role mapping, and incremental delta sync (~30-90s typical).
Sam W: Customer will use Okta as authoritative source for groups. They want explicit mapping: Okta group "NB-Admins" -> Redwood role Admin. Also asked about attribute name.
Prashant (Security): Security quick answers: we encrypt SCIM tokens at rest with our KMS by default; we can support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated. Audit logs retention: default 90d, we can extend to 365d as a paid add-on or included for Dedicated.
Marie (PS): Drafting runbook. Need minimal SAML attributes to send to their Okta admin and an example SCIM PATCH for role assignment.
Alisa (SE): Paste SAML attribute example to hand over:
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="urn:nova:role">
    <AttributeValue>Admin</AttributeValue>
  </AttributeStatement>
```
Also SCIM group mapping note: we accept the following attributes on group: displayName, members[]. For delta sync we honor "roles" in custom extension: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:redwood:2.0:Role.
Prashant (Security): Add to SQ: Q: Are SAML assertions validated? A: Yes, we validate signature, audience, time skew and support cert rollover. Q: Is SCIM token stored? A: Encrypted in KMS, rotated on request.
Jordan (AE): Pricing note: offering 30-day POC at 50% hosted credits. Post-POC options: continue hosted (usage-based) or move to Dedicated (capacity commit). Need to confirm if 1yr audit retention can be offered within POC price.
Sam W: Legal says 1yr retention is fine as a one-off for the POC with a signed addendum. @Prashant can you confirm this is acceptable from a compliance POV?
Prashant (Security): OK for POC with addendum. Will include SOC2 appendix and note on log access controls. One caveat: audit export to customer S3 requires Dedicated or enterprise add-on.
Marie (PS): POC acceptance criteria proposal: 1) SSO login success for 3 admin users from Okta; 2) SCIM create + update for 25 users including role assignment; 3) Group->role mapping validated for Admin/Editor/Viewer; 4) Audit events visible for those ops for the POC window; 5) DNS-based domain verification completed.
Alisa (SE): Technical constraints: Provisioning rate default 20 req/s (can be increased on Dedicated). Initial sync of 25 users is trivial. We don't support automatic subdomain wildcard domain claims.
Jordan (AE): I'll schedule kickoff with their Okta engineer Tue 9am PST. I'll send POC addendum and pricing sheet beforehand.
Sam W: Uploaded security questionnaire + template here: https://redwood.co/internal/sq/nova-poc. Please annotate.
Marie (PS): I'll join the kickoff to run through the runbook and acceptance tests. Also will prepare a short checklist for Okta mapping and the DNS TXT value.
Jordan (AE): Thanks all. I'll post the calendar invite and attach the quote. Will update thread after kickoff. :thumbsup:
